method: atan(rise / going) from the declared 153 mm by 360 mm.
used_for: Whether the stair reads as processional or as a ladder, and the comparison against a 42-degree service stair.
wrong_if: Nothing — it is arithmetic on two numbers I chose. This is a DESIGN figure rather than a measurement, and the layer marks it as such so nobody mistakes it for a fact about the world.
